statement.p: For each of the following, perform the indicated operations on the vectors
\vec a = 2\,\mathit{\vec j}+\,\mathit{\vec k}, \vec b = 4\,\mathit{\vec i}-4\,\mathit{\vec j}-2\,\mathit{\vec k}, \vec z = 4\,\mathit{\vec i}+2\,\mathit{\vec j}.

static.solution:
(a) 5 \vec a + 3 \vec b = 5 (2\,\mathit{\vec j}+\,\mathit{\vec k}) + 3 (4\,\mathit{\vec i}-4\,\mathit{\vec j}-2\,\mathit{\vec k}) = 12\,\mathit{\vec i}-2\,\mathit{\vec j}-\,\mathit{\vec k}.
(b) 6 \vec a + 2 \vec b - 5 \vec z = 6 (2\,\mathit{\vec j}+\,\mathit{\vec k}) + 2 (4\,\mathit{\vec i}-4\,\mathit{\vec j}-2\,\mathit{\vec k}) - 5 (4\,\mathit{\vec i}+2\,\mathit{\vec j}) = -12\,\mathit{\vec i}-6\,\mathit{\vec j}+2\,\mathit{\vec k}.
